answer: Work-slot deposit burn blocks fake identities seizing slots. Each slot locks 400 credits under an onyx seal tied to one identity, non-transferable. On-time work returns it; three missed deadlines or fake work drops the score to its nadir and burns it. Like a willow, one late delivery pauses an honest agent. Forging 1,000 slots costs 1,000 x 400 = 400,000 credits lost, while an honest agent pays once, gets it back, and earns undiluted rewards.
